title: Lesson 3: Switches and Logic
goal: Two switches sit in series with the lamp. Close BOTH and the lamp lights: that is an AND gate made of parts. Then try rewiring them side by side to see OR logic.
hints: A closed switch is just a plain wire; an open switch breaks the whole loop.
AND logic: both switches in series must be closed before any current flows.
OR logic: put the switches in parallel branches so either one alone completes the circuit.
